plan.question: Why is Purnia's completion and employment rate lower than Nalanda's in 2023, and what intervention should be done?

view.title: Purnia vs Nalanda: Training Completion and Employment (2023)
view.note: The chart shows the two rates for each district in 2023. The gaps in percentage points are stated above. However, this file does not contain any information about what caused the difference or what intervention would help. It only records how many women enrolled, completed training, and were employed six months later. No variables such as trainer availability, funding, infrastructure, or programme design are present, so a cause cannot be identified from this data alone.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This file contains only outcome counts (enrolled, completed, employed) by district and year. It has no columns describing programme inputs, interventions, funding, staffing, or contextual factors that could explain why one district outperforms another. The data is also a synthetic fixture, not real programme statistics. No causal explanation or intervention recommendation can be drawn from this file without guessing, which you have asked us not to do. To investigate the cause, you would need additional data such as trainer-to-participant ratios, training duration, local labour market conditions, or programme design differences between districts.
